text: If a man has a good friend to resist him in doing bad actions, he will have his reputation preserved; so if a father has a son to resist his wrong commands, he will be saved from committing serious faults.
author: Confucius and Zengzi
speaker: Confucius
reference: The Classic of Filial Piety (Xiao Jing)
locator: Chapter XV, The Question of Remonstrance
